name: paeonia
description: Paeonia monorepo - iOS app, marketing site, and backend infrastructure

scripts.swiftlint: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; for arg in "$@"; do if [ "$arg" = "--fix" ] || [ "$arg" = "autocorrect" ]; then echo "swiftlint autocorrect is disabled in this repo. Use swift-format once configured."; exit 1; fi; done; swiftlint lint "$@"' --
